# Web Appendix A: Stimuli and Measures

Each section of the web appendix begins on a new page. Use the heading
styles of the main document.

## Brand Loyalty Scale

@tbl-items lists the items of the brand loyalty scale.

| Item                                           | M    | SD   |
|:-----------------------------------------------|-----:|-----:|
| I intend to keep buying this brand.            | 4.35 | 1.21 |
| I would recommend this brand to others.        | 4.12 | 1.30 |
| I consider myself loyal to this brand.         | 4.02 | 1.28 |
| I would pay more for this brand than for others. | 4.33 | 1.17 |

: Items of the Brand Loyalty Scale {#tbl-items}

::: {.notes}
All items were measured on seven-point scales (1 = "strongly disagree," and
7 = "strongly agree").
:::

# Web Appendix B: Robustness Checks

The results hold when the model includes demographic control variables:

$$
\text{Loyalty}_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \text{Trust}_i + \beta_2 \text{Familiarity}_i + \boldsymbol{\gamma}'\mathbf{Z}_i + \varepsilon_i.
$$ {#eq-controls}

@tbl-controls reports the estimates of @eq-controls. List references that
are cited only in the web appendix at its end [@cateora1996].

| Predictor         | Estimate | SE  | p    |
|:------------------|---------:|----:|-----:|
| Influencer trust  |      .36 | .08 | .000 |
| Brand familiarity |      .24 | .07 | .001 |
| Age               |      .01 | .01 | .412 |

: The Effect of Influencer Trust Is Robust to Demographic Controls {#tbl-controls}
